mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MEMBER_PASSWORD AS memberPassword, MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER AS memberPhoneNumber, RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER AS residentRegistrationNumber, PRIMARY_ADDRESS AS primaryAddress, DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress, POSTAL_CODE AS postalCode, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT E.MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber, E.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS departmentCode, E.POSITION_CODE AS positionCode, D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS departmentName, P.POSITION_NAME AS positionName FROM EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPARTMENT_CODE = E.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_CODE = E.POSITION_CODE WHERE E.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}
